mainEntity.name: Should my veterinary practice prioritize AEO over traditional SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: A veterinary practice should not necessarily prioritize AEO over traditional SEO, but rather integrate both into a comprehensive digital marketing strategy. Traditional SEO builds your overall online presence and organic rankings, which are foundational. AEO refines this by targeting direct answers and featured snippets, capturing a different segment of search intent. Both strategies work synergistically: strong SEO helps your content get noticed, while AEO ensures it gets selected as the best answer, ultimately leading to greater visibility and client acquisition. It's about optimizing for the full search journey.
acceptedAnswer.description: Veterinary practices should integrate both AEO and traditional SEO, not prioritize one over the other. Both work together to enhance overall visibility and client acquisition.
